name: eufy Video Doorbell E340 (US)

matter.note: No Matter claim found in the eufy pages checked; the CSA database was not searched.

apple_home.note: eufy's spec sheet lists Works with HomeKit as N for the E340, and its FAQ says HomeKit is not currently supported.

google_home.note: Google Assistant works through the eufy Security integration. eufy's spec sheet lists voice-command streaming only; two-way talk, motion announcements and doorbell-press announcements are listed as not supported. Google Home speakers cannot act as a chime.

alexa.note: Linked with the eufy Security Alexa skill. The spec sheet lists voice-command streaming and doorbell-press announcements as supported; two-way talk and motion announcements are listed as not supported. Echo devices can act as a chime.

home_assistant.note: eufy's third-party platform list marks Home Assistant as not supported, but that article is not clearly specific to the E340, so it is not treated as a firm no. Community integrations exist but are unofficial.

hubRequired.note: The doorbell has 8 GB of its own storage and works with an existing chime; a HomeBase S280 or S380 is optional.

localControl.note: eufy does not state whether control works without its cloud. Recording is local, but app and voice control were not confirmed to be local.

power.note: Removable battery pack, or wired to doorbell wiring. The US page asks for 8–24 V; the EU page for 16–24 V.

localStorage.note: 8 GB built into the doorbell; a HomeBase S380 adds 16 GB and can be expanded with an internal drive. eufy's retention figures differ between pages.

subscription.note: eufy markets the doorbell as working without a subscription; whether optional paid plans exist was not checked.

summary: eufy Video Doorbell E340 has two cameras, one aimed at visitors and one at the ground for packages, and records to 8 GB of built-in storage. It runs on a battery or doorbell wiring and uses 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. Alexa and Google Assistant are supported with limited features, and eufy states there is no HomeKit support.
caveats: Alexa and Google Assistant support is limited: no two-way talk and no motion announcements; Google also lacks doorbell-press announcements.
Wiring requirements differ between US and EU pages.
